deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry; applications after it are not guaranteed equal consideration.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt if the applicant completed the whole of secondary education up to and including the equivalent of year 12 (including a GCSE-equivalent English language qualification) in a country on the Home Office's list of recognised countries, or has completed a recognised UK degree. US applicants: a US national with GCSE-equivalent (Grade 11) qualifications to the required level needs no additional evidence (US country page).

english.notes: IELTS Academic. Lowest undergraduate band (6.0 / 5.5, e.g. Mechanical Engineering BEng); Computer Science and Economics need 6.5 with 6.0 in each element; the highest band is 7.0 with 6.0. Tests valid for 2 years.
Tests taken up to January 2026 (0-120 scale), lowest band. Middle band (6.5 IELTS) 90 overall: Writing/Listening 19, Reading 20, Speaking 22. No best-score combining across tests.

Tests taken after January 2026 (1-6 scale), lowest band: 4.5 overall with no less than 4.0 in each element. Middle band (6.5 IELTS): 4.5 overall with no less than 4.5 in each element; highest band 5.0 with no less than 4.5.
PTE Academic, lowest band: 65 (minimum 59). Middle band (6.5 IELTS): 71 (minimum 65); highest band 76 (minimum 65).

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 26th of 130 UK universities (B = ranks 16-40 on the national scale).
